title: Koala cathelicidin PhciCath5 has antimicrobial activity, including against Chlamydia pecorum.
summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the worker-4/worker-6 blocker: DBAASP MIC rows now map to Table 2 row and footnote evidence, final activity includes Table 2 plus C. pecorum Fig 5 phenotype rows, and mechanism claims are separated into direct permeability, phenotype-supported activity, and inferred membrane-model claims. APD6-only annotation/narrative caveats remain visible as cautions.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-opened packet XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database materials and accepted the paper with cautions after row-level database reconciliation and final-source adjudication.

materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets_detail: S1/S2 TIF captions/images and S1-S3 DOCX OOXML tables were opened; landing*.bin files are HTML landing pages and not primary data tables.
materials_exhausted.merged_database_rows_detail: packet linked JSONL rows plus merged APD6/DBAASP sequence/assay CSV rows checked

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and experiment rows are source_verified against Table 2 and Table 1. APD6 sequence/citation are source-backed, but APD6 disulfide annotation and narrative activity summary remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows preserve 28 DBAASP/Table 2 MIC values including bracket/rowspan/serum/blood values, plus two C. pecorum Fig 5 phenotype rows. No mammalian toxicity row is reported in the paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism is limited to E. coli membrane permeability. C. pecorum evidence is phenotype-supported EB inactivation, and the broader electrostatic/membrane model remains inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: No blocking or major rework target remains after bounded source review; acceptance is with cautions because database annotations exceed explicit primary-source statements in APD6 and exact Fig 5 bar heights are not table-transcribed.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 1 verifies PhciCath5 sequence/name; APD6 includes a 1S=S-style annotation not explicitly stated in the primary paper. Preserved as source_conflict rather than smoothed.
APD6 activity text is an updated narrative summary. Primary Table 2 and Fig 5 values were separately captured as final activity rows.
Fig 5 exact bar heights are not transcribed in local source tables; final rows keep only source-supported magnitude/significance.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The primary source provides Fig 5 as a raster plot plus textual magnitude/significance, but no underlying numeric table of exact IFU bar heights is present in local XML/DOCX/packet materials.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Final activity evidence preserves the source-supported >2-order IFU reduction and p<0.0001 without fabricating exact bar values; no linked database row depends on the exact plotted heights.
